national.title: How to Apply for a New PAN Card Online in India (Form 49A - 2026)
national.summary: Step-by-step guide to applying for a new Permanent Account Number using Form 49A on the Protean or UTIITSL portal. Verified statutory fee of ₹107 for dispatch within India and instant digital e-PAN delivery.

steps.title: Select Application Type (Form 49A) on Official Portal
steps.description: Choose 'Application Type: New PAN - Indian Citizen (Form 49A)' and select category as 'INDIVIDUAL'.
steps.where: Official Income Tax Authorized TIN Portal
steps.calloutText: Only Protean and UTIITSL are legally authorized by the Income Tax Department to issue PAN cards.

steps.title: Enter Applicant Personal Details and Generate Token Number
steps.description: Enter full name, date of birth, active email address, and mobile number. Save the generated 10-digit temporary token number.
steps.calloutText: The 10-digit token allows you to resume your draft application if your session times out.

steps.title: Choose Document Submission Mode (Aadhaar Paperless e-KYC)
steps.description: Select 'Submit digitally through e-KYC & e-Sign (Paperless)' for instant photo and signature import without sending physical papers.

steps.title: Provide Parent Details and Choose Name on Card
steps.description: Enter your father's and mother's names. Select whether your father's or mother's name should be printed on the PAN card.

steps.title: Enter Source of Income and Residential Address
steps.description: Select your income source and confirm your address. For Aadhaar e-KYC, the address from your Aadhaar is imported automatically.

steps.title: Select Assessing Officer (AO) Code
steps.description: Select your Indian state and city to view jurisdictional AO codes. Click your ward or circle to auto-populate the code.
steps.calloutText: Select 'Individual' and your city to pick the matching ward circle for proper tax jurisdiction.

steps.title: Pay Statutory Government Application Fee Online
steps.description: Pay the statutory fee of ₹107 for physical card delivery within India using credit card, debit card, or UPI.
steps.where: Integrated Payment Gateway (Bharatkosh / Net Banking / UPI)

steps.title: Authenticate Aadhaar e-Sign and Receive e-PAN
steps.description: Enter the OTP received on your Aadhaar-linked mobile to complete e-sign. Digital e-PAN is delivered to your email within 48 hours.

rejectionReasons.title: Name Spelling Mismatch Against Aadhaar Database
rejectionReasons.description: If the applicant's name entered in Form 49A differs even by one letter from Aadhaar records, the application fails.
rejectionReasons.solution: Enter your first, middle, and last name exactly as printed on your Aadhaar card.

rejectionReasons.title: Blurry or Cropped Photo Upload in Scanned Mode
rejectionReasons.description: Uploading a mobile selfie or blurry low-resolution image fails Protean automated optical quality checks.
rejectionReasons.solution: Scan a formal studio photograph in 200 DPI resolution with plain white background under 50 KB.

rejectionReasons.title: Unclear Signature on Ruled or Tinted Paper
rejectionReasons.description: Signatures written across ruled lined paper or with light blue ink fail automatic legibility scans.
rejectionReasons.solution: Sign firmly using a black ballpoint pen on unlined plain white paper and scan at 200 DPI.

rejectionReasons.title: Selecting Incorrect AO Code
rejectionReasons.description: Entering an Assessing Officer code belonging to another jurisdiction or company tier delays issuance.
rejectionReasons.solution: Use the portal AO finder to select your resident city and individual ward circle.

rejectionReasons.title: Already Possessing an Active PAN Card
rejectionReasons.description: Under Section 272B of the Income Tax Act, possessing more than one PAN is illegal and attracts a ₹10,000 penalty.
rejectionReasons.solution: Do not apply for a new PAN if you already have one; apply for a reprint or correction instead.

rejectionReasons.title: Minor Applying Without Parent Representative Details
rejectionReasons.description: Form 49A for an applicant below 18 years submitted without guardian declaration and proof is rejected.
rejectionReasons.solution: Fill out section 14 of Form 49A with parent details and upload guardian identity and address proof.

faqItems.question: Can an individual hold more than one PAN card in India?
faqItems.answer: No. Possessing more than one PAN card is illegal under Section 272B and carries a penalty of ₹10,000.

faqItems.question: What is the statutory government fee for a new physical PAN card?
faqItems.answer: The statutory fee is ₹107 for delivery within India, which includes ₹91 base processing fee plus 18% GST.

faqItems.question: How long does it take to receive a PAN card after applying?
faqItems.answer: The digital e-PAN is emailed within 2 to 3 days, and the physical plastic card arrives in 10 to 15 days.

faqItems.question: Can I apply for a PAN card completely online without sending physical papers?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Selecting 'Aadhaar e-KYC & e-Sign' makes the entire application 100% paperless without mailing any forms.

faqItems.question: Is Aadhaar mandatory for applying for a new PAN card?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Section 139AA of the Income Tax Act makes quoting your Aadhaar number mandatory for Indian citizens.

faqItems.question: Can a minor under 18 years of age get a PAN card?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Minors can apply through their parents or legal guardians acting as representative assessee.

faqItems.question: What is the difference between an e-PAN and a physical PAN card?
faqItems.answer: Both have equal legal validity. An e-PAN is a digitally signed PDF, while the physical card is plastic laminated.

faqItems.question: How can I track my PAN card application status online?
faqItems.answer: Visit the Protean or UTIITSL tracking portal and enter your 15-digit application acknowledgment number.
